VidChapters Dataset for Chapter-Llama
	

This repository contains the dataset used in the paper "Chapter-Llama: Efficient Chaptering in Hour-Long Videos with LLMs" (CVPR 2025).

	
		
		Overview
	

VidChapters-7M is a large-scale dataset for video chaptering, containing:

817k videos with ASR data (20GB)
Captions extracted from videos using various sampling strategies
Chapter annotations with timestamps and titles
